description: Add a service address to an existing customer - the place work is done, which a job is then booked against. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Housecall Pro wants street, city, state, zip and country together on this route and rejects a partial address, so all five are required here. Nothing is sent to the customer. Housecall Pro's API has no route that changes or removes an address once it is on a customer, so get it right before adding it - a wrong one is corrected in Housecall Pro.

country.description: Required on this route even for a domestic address, e.g. "US"

name: hcp_create_customer_address
